newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Four dead as NZ train hits car on crossing.
newsitem.headline: Four dead as NZ train hits car on crossing.

text.p: Four people were killed on Thursday when a train ploughed into a car on an uncontrolled level crossing in New Zealand's South Island, police said.

Senior Sergeant Gavin Herridge said all four dead were in the blue Subaru car, which was sliced in half. One body was found about 100 metres (yards) away in long grass, and debris was scattered alongside the railway tracks.
Two victims were female, one male, and the sex of the fourth was not known. Police described all four as middle-aged.
Rail company Tranz Rail said none of the 70 passengers and three crew on board the train was hurt.
